richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will be recalled to have the tail light assembly checked. Where necessary the outer tail light will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: REAR SIDE/BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL

richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will be recalled to have the tail light assembly checked. Where necessary the outer tail light will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: REAR SIDE/BRAKE LIGHTS MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: The rear tie-rods may not confirm to the correct manufacturing specification. Therefore depending on its usage and the road conditions it is possible that the tie-rod may become damaged and may fail which will result in the loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the tie-rods.
richiami.titolo: LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to the installation of incorrect software the seatbelt warning buzzer may not sound when the seatbelts are not engaged.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the current software upgraded.
richiami.titolo: SEATBELT WARNING BUZZER MAY NOT SOUND

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to the installation of incorrect software the seatbelt warning buzzer may not sound when the seatbelts are not engaged.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the current software upgraded.
richiami.titolo: SEATBELT WARNING BUZZER MAY NOT SOUND

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that during manufacture an incorrect tightening torque may have been applied to the front suspension ball joint retaining nuts. This can result in the ball joint becoming loose in it's taper and in extreme circumstances an increase in wear may cause the suspension arm to break.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject ball joint retaining nuts checked for correct torque. Should this not be the case both suspension levers and the hub carrier will be changed.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM COULD FAIL.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that during manufacture an incorrect tightening torque may have been applied to the front suspension ball joint retaining nuts. This can result in the ball joint becoming loose in it's taper and in extreme circumstances an increase in wear may cause the suspension arm to break.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject ball joint retaining nuts checked for correct torque. Should this not be the case both suspension levers and the hub carrier will be changed.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION ARM COULD FAIL.

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of fire because of leaks from the fuel lines in the engine compartment. Defective fuel lines are being replaced by lines with metal coverings.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the manufacturer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The product poses a risk of fire because of leaks from the fuel lines in the engine compartment.

richiami.difetto: Due to an anomaly in the ABS/ASR software the Electronic Stability Programme may be disabled. The condition only occurs with the ignition in Key on position and the vehicle battery in a low state of charge
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace ABS/ASR ECU.
richiami.titolo: ELECTRONIC STABILITY PROGRAMME MAY BE DISABLED

richiami.difetto: Due to a printing error in the Owner's Manual and Quick Reference Guide the operation of the rear door child safety locks is incorrectly detailed. As a consequence the driver may not operate the door child safety locks correctly.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the information pertaining to the operation of the rear door child safety locks updated.
richiami.titolo: REAR DOOR SAFETY LOCK INSTRUCTIONS IN MANUAL INCORRECT.

richiami.difetto: The steering rack sub-frame may develop a crack in the area of the two fixing points nearest the steering column. This could result in the steering rack becoming loose and a reduction of vehicle control. Potential early symptoms noticed by the driver could be vibrations noises and unusual feeling through the steering wheel.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and weld brackets of improved design to the sub-frame.
richiami.titolo: STEERING RACK SUB-FRAME MAY CRACK

richiami.difetto: Due to a possible manufacturing defect there is a risk that the internal wiring harness of the door handle may short circuit and trigger the electrical door opening switch of the door. This may result in the door opening without intervention although onboard software of the central locking does not allow this situation to occur over 6mph.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the outside door handles.
richiami.titolo: SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR ON THE ELECTRICAL DOOR OPENING

richiami.difetto: Due to a possible manufacturing defect there is a risk that the fuel hose may separate where the rubber hose joins the metal connector. this may result in fuel leaking into the engine bay with the attendant fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace pipe with modified type
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT THE FUEL HOSE MAY SEPARATE

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that steering rack fixing bolts may become loose which may result in impaired steering control
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will be recalled and the subject bolts replaced with quality assured items.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT STEERING RACK FIXING BOLTS MAY BECOME LOOSE

richiami.difetto: The fixing bolts holding the steering idler arms to the chassis may not conform to specification. This may cause the bolts to loosen and result in a loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Fit quality assured replacement fixing bolts.
richiami.titolo: STEERING IDLER ARM FIXING BOLTS MAY LOOSEN

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of a crack appearing in the ninety degree union connecting the vacuum hose to the brake servo unit which may result in loss of servo assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace union with modified type.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF SERVO ASSISTANCE
